blurb: Avalon Golf Links offers a 27-hole golf experience with three exceptional 9-hole layouts overlooking Skagit Valley and panoramic views of the Olympic and Cascade ranges. The club is accessible from Seattle and Vancouver, BC, and hosts tournaments and events year-round. Memberships and event hosting options are available.
